ev.q: Influenza vaccination coverage was 81.0% among HCP at acute care hospitals and 47.1% among those working at nursing homes
Up-to-date COVID-19 vaccination coverage was 17.2% among HCP working at acute care hospitals
Influenza vaccination coverage was 81.0% among HCP at acute care hospitals and 47.1% among those working at nursing homes
Among HCP working in acute care hospitals, influenza vaccination coverage was highest in the Midwest (84.7%) and lowest in the Pacific region (74.4%)
Acute care hospitals and nursing homes report data to NHSN according to surveillance protocols

methods_quotes.q: Pooled mean influenza and up-to-date COVID-19 vaccination coverage rates were calculated as the number of HCP who had received
HCP reported to have a medical contraindication to COVID-19 vaccination were subtracted from the denominator
Facilities reporting data for both vaccine types and employing at least five HCP were included in the analysis.
Results were further stratified by employment category (employee, licensed practitioner, and student or volunteer)
therefore, statistical comparisons of vaccination coverage were not conducted.
All analyses were conducted using SAS (version 9.4; SAS Institute).
